reviews.title: Looks Like a Good Tool, Then
reviews.text: … then it refuses to see my camera; after a few circles with AI support and not being able to send screenshots of what is broken for me, the AI bot says, "Oh yeah, the chat support won’t take image files". We go a few more circles where the bot tells me to try the same steps several more times and that it will pass this off to a "human". Meanwhile, that video I really needed to make, the one where I really need a teleprompter tool to make it? The time window for getting that done has closed. Also, the font in the support chat is inhumanly small like much of this app’s UI and there’s no way to adjust that; the older I get, lack of app-level font size adjustment creeps closer to my #1 support gripe. Usually, a developer will point me to the OS-level font adjustments as a "solution"—which is a major cop out. I don’ t need the OS fonts bigger, I need your anti-old person’s eyes app to be less of a jerk …

reviews.title: Camera is listed but the capture session never starts
reviews.text:
Teleprompter 13.2.1 (1512) on macOS 27.0.1, Mac mini with no built-in camera or microphone. The only device is a Logitech C922 Pro Stream Webcam. It is also the default microphone. Other apps on this Mac open the camera and record without trouble.

In Teleprompter the webcam appears in the camera button at the bottom right, and I can select C922 Pro Stream Webcam. The preview still says the camera is unavailable and that another app may be using it. Starting a recording fails with the same camera-or-microphone message. The resolution, frame rate, and stabilization controls do not change: 720p stays highlighted, and HD, 4K, and the frame rate tab do not respond.

Camera and microphone access for Teleprompter are already enabled in System Settings. Quitting the other video apps does not help.

reviews.title: BEWARE! Unexpected £90 subscription charge
reviews.text: Every time I attempted to cancel my free trial, the app extended the trial period instead. I only used the app once and never intended to purchase an annual subscription. I was subsequently charged £90 and requested a refund on the very same day, but it was refused. Most apps would offer a refund when a subscription is cancelled immediately after renewal, as this clearly suggests an unintended purchase. Despite explaining the circumstances, the company still refused. Extremely disappointing and questionable business practices. Avoid!

reviews.title: Voice Scrolling Lagged
reviews.text:
It didn’t work for me because the voice scrolling greatly lagged behind my voice, causing me to have to pause talking. It’s not just that the words didn’t scroll up to the cue mark in a timely manner, they were totally off the screen. 

I tried closing all apps and rebooting my iPhone 17 Pro, but that didn’t solve the problem. I’ve tried a number of teleprompter apps with voice scrolling, and they all lag a little but this was the worst I’ve seen. Thinking it might be something about my iPhone configuration, and went back to my former app and it didn’t have the lag. 

I have cancelled my trial subscription. You may not experience this problem, so give it a try. It just didn’t work for me.

reviews.title: Don’t get it.
reviews.text:
App is set to auto start every time you restart your computer with no obvious way to turn it off.

When closing the app down, I am prompted to select a subscription plan with no obvious way to ignore the message or just say no.

No recording quality settings when using the inbuilt recording system.

As someone who has used professional prompters and video editing suites, I found the user interface difficult to navigate.

One positive note, the scroll via following spoken word works well, even with a child who was not speaking clearly.

At this price point, this app is a rip off.

reviews.title: Poor customer service
reviews.text: I needed to try this out to see if it would work for my situation. It didn’t, but no issues with the app. But got busy and of course no notice and a charge shows up for an entire year subscription. That day (like a few hours after the trial expires and the charge posted) I submitted for a refund. Bear in mind I used this once and it doesn’t fit my purpose. It was denied. No reason given. I appealed and explained what I’m saying here and appeal was denied and again no reason given. So they basically stole almost 100 bucks of my money and I didn’t use nor will ever use this product. This is ridiculous. So stay away from this app if you’re not 100% sure you want it.
